hypothesis: Transplanting the locked S&P Phase 2F validation-pooled diffusion protocol unchanged to the untouched FTSE 100 market improves latent factor-state forecasts. Primary: Gaussian-VAR-base pool composite ratio versus VAR-GARCH below 1.0 with both co-primary losses not exceeding VAR-GARCH. Prespecified secondary: Student-t-VAR-base pool versus Student-t VAR under the same rule.
data_boundary: FTSE 100 observations: training through 2022-12-30 and 2023 validation may be used for fitting and selection; post-2023 observations are downloaded only after the protocol commit hash is externally notarized, and are scored exactly once. December 2023 universe snapshot sha256 13d55d86de45153ef68cf630549a1f054998d1a64979868a1dca0e72d04dddcf; eligible universe is the leading 100 manifest entries passing the 95 percent coverage screen dated 2022-12-30; market benchmark ISF.L.
decision_rule: For each pool: success requires geometric-mean co-primary ratio below 1.0 and neither co-primary point estimate exceeding the pool baseline; paired origin bootstraps and dependence-robust inference are reported. The primary decision is the Gaussian-base pool against VAR-GARCH; the secondary decision is the Student-t-base pool against Student-t VAR. Results are preserved whether or not the rules pass; the consumed FTSE 2024-2026 sample cannot be reused for selection.
integrity_note: Do not modify this file after registration. Record outcomes in a separate result artifact, including failures.
